propositions: CodeQL workflow cadence changed from weekly (23 4 * * 1) to 6-hourly (35 */6 * * *) to restore coverage parity with the original push-on-main trigger after removal of push events in favor of scheduled CI.
The operator determined the weekly cadence rationale (cost/28x increase) no longer applies because navapbc/rebar is a public repository where CodeQL and GitHub Actions minutes are free.

CodeQL must remain schedule-only with no push trigger and retain workflow_dispatch, requiring introduction of a separate schedule-only 6-hourly cohort in test assertions rather than joining the existing _SIX_HOURLY tuple.
The four 6-hourly lanes (test.yml :41, optionality.yml :47, verify-identity.yml :53, codeql.yml :35) must use distinct off-the-hour minutes to prevent scheduler congestion at the top of the hour.
